goals: Verify that a comment can be successfully updated via the API, returning a success status, and that the changes are persisted in the database.
Verify that the API returns an appropriate error status (e.g., 404) when an update request is made with missing required content.
activities: Insert a test user into the 'users' collection.
Send a POST request to the '/comment' endpoint with authorization and test comment data.
Extract the ID of the created comment from the response.
Send a PUT request to the '/comment/:id' endpoint with authorization and updated content.
Assert that the response status is 200.
Assert that the response type is 'application/json'.
Find the updated comment in the 'comments' collection by its ID.
Assert that the content of the updated comment in the database matches 'music is my life'.
Send a PUT request to the '/comment/:id' endpoint with authorization but missing content.
Assert that the response status is 404.
Delete the test user from the 'users' collection.
Delete the test comment from the 'comments' collection.
